by: societies session, step 4.1 (for the integrator to append at societies-1)
title: The old estate's incorporated-society and officer tables, exported once from nzbn_canonical in three parts

landmarks: gzip of JSON lines; line one is a header with t = export, part, counts, note
every later line has t = society | officer | ask and an nzbn

signals_note: Not a document the register published: an export of nzbn_canonical's bulk.other_incorporated_entities_core_data (Incorporated Society rows, the August 2026 monthly file, with its vanished rows), public.society_officers (parsed from the NZBN API v5 entity detail by the old nightly sweep, 13 to 20 October 2026; the answers were not kept) and public.society_sweep_log, made once on 20 October 2026. Every row from it is 'taken from the old estate's tables; original not held'.
notes: The officer table holds no address. unique_identifier is one value per society, not per role. The register gives no role number: a role is keyed on its society, names and start. The old sweep replaced a society's officers only when an ask parsed some, so a society whose last ask gave none keeps an earlier ask's rows.
applies_to: the old estate's incorporated-society register copy, as of 20 October 2026
process: Key a society on its NZBN, else its incorporation number; an officer on its society, names and start; the window is the register's own start and end.
gates: Every export line is a row or a catch-log line.
Each part's line count equals the old table's own count in its header.
Each society's officers equal what its last ask gave, or are logged as kept from an earlier ask.
The registered societies on the file's date against the register's own count (check.py).

by: societies session, step 4.1 (for the integrator to append at societies-1)
title: The NZBN register's entity detail for one incorporated society, as the API answered one ask

landmarks: a JSON object with nzbn, entityName, entityTypeCode, entityStatusDescription
roles: a list of objects with roleType, roleStatus, startDate, endDate, rolePerson or roleEntity

signals_note: GET https://api.business.govt.nz/gateway/nzbn/v5/entities/{nzbn} with our own subscription key, through the fetch gate; the bytes landed verbatim by hash.
notes: Only roleType Officer is read; an officer that is a body (roleEntity) is logged, not read. Any address a role carries goes to societies_private.officer_addresses and nowhere else.
applies_to: incorporated societies on the NZBN register, from 20 October 2026
process: Key an officer on its society, names and start, as the export does, so an ask and the export name the same role alike.
gates: Every role is a row or a catch-log line.
